content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to scale pressure transmitters for use in my [product_name] program so I can use the actual values in a PI controller. One transmitter operates from 0 to 25 Bar with a 4-20mA output, while the other ranges from -1 to 20 Bar with the same output type. Here is some data about the transmitters: [url]. When I set the analog amplifier to sensor type 4-20mA and match the transmitter range, the system tells me this is incompatible with a gain/offset. Can anyone advise how to set this up properly? Thanks in advance from someone new to [product_name] programming.

Hi, here's an example setup for both sensors. The ranges are 0 to 25 Bar and -1 to 20 Bar. If you remove every second Analog Amplifier in the sequence, the range changes to 0 to 250 and -10 to 200. Hope this helps.

If you can't represent the exact value range due to internal calculation limitations, try to minimize calculation error. For example, if 0-25 Bar can only be set as 0-24 Bar (so there's a 1 Bar difference), use finer resolution. A range from -1 to 2503 would work well in this case. This way, the calculation error is shifted to the second decimal place and becomes negligible.
Thanks, now I understand how to approach this!
